title: Database
description: Everything the application has saved: back up, put a backup back, upkeep.

backup.title: Back up
backup.description: Downloads a full copy of all the data in a single file.
backup.hint: Keep this file somewhere safe (USB stick, another computer). Make one before every important change.

restore.title: Put a backup back
restore.description: Replaces all the data of the application with the data of a backup file.
restore.warning: The current sales, products, customers and accounts will be erased and replaced by those of the file. Everyone will have to sign in again. Download a backup of the current state first.
restore.understood: I understand that all the current data will be replaced.
restore.running: Putting it back… do not close the page
restore.confirmDescription: The current data will be replaced by the data of the file “{{file}}”. This cannot be undone.
restore.doneDescription: {{rows}} rows put back. Sign in again.

maintenance.title: Upkeep
maintenance.description: Small technical operations, without risk for the data.

analyze.title: Speed up searches
analyze.description: Updates the information the database uses to search quickly.

purge-expired.title: Clean up finished sign-ins
purge-expired.description: Erases expired sign-ins and old attempt counters.

unlock-sign-in.title: Unblock sign-ins
unlock-sign-in.description: Lets people blocked after too many wrong passwords try again at once.

end-all-sessions.title: Sign everyone out
end-all-sessions.description: Every user will have to sign in again, on every device. You stay signed in.
